what: Blind audit of every benign 'friends joking and teasing each other' row in the two unseen-generator test sets (Llama 23 rows, Qwen3 23 rows), read without seeing any model output.
rater: one reader (a Claude model); not independent annotation
policy: Friendly teasing with a mild insult is benign (user decision, 2026-09-30). Real cruelty is not.

rubric.friendly: playful, mutual, mild teasing or trash-talk; nobody is hurt; nothing demeaning, threatening or excluding
rubric.cruel: demeaning or humiliating insults, repeated targeting, exclusion, threats, or one person clearly upset

unclear_rows.llama:xg-benign-041: joke telling the other to diet; a body comment, though both laugh
unclear_rows.qwen3:xg-benign-005: two friends mock a third classmate's blue hair; teasing an absent person
unclear_rows.qwen3:xg-benign-120: 'you're such a failure' followed by reassurance, then 'see you later, loser' / 'you're the loser!'

note: Every other row in these two sets' teasing scene was judged friendly. The earlier claim that many flagged rows were arguable labels (false-alarm-audit.md, seeds-hardneg.md) was mostly wrong: the model's roughly 50% flag rate on this scene is largely real false alarms.
